say:7:1341125006:1.text: The battlefield isn't a duel arena. No one follows the one-on-one rule, there are no referees, no designated space, and no carefully chosen equipment.

say:8:1341125007:1.text: Either you survive or be killed.

say:9:1341125008:1.text: So, many moves designed for duels end up being too complicated for the real world. I've learned a lot of more straightforward techniques through battle.
